title: POST /api/clients/{client_id}/rotate-token (200, 202)
description: Admin only. The rotation is stored first and survives a hub restart. 200: the integration delivered the new token within the wait time (ha_token_status, ha_token_minted_at; the app was told via client_config_updated). 202 status rotation_requested: sent to the integration, no answer yet. 202 status pending: the integration is not connected; the rotation runs as soon as it is (provisioning[] on its next poll, retry loop once its push session is up), answered at once. 202 status pending also for a device with remote access (remote_allowed) that is not connected to the hub (away): the rotation is deferred until the device connects to the hub (it is home and fetches the new token at once), at the latest after 72 h; then it runs anyway (audit log, no endless deferral). There is no separate status value for this; the admin UI tells the case apart by remote_allowed and is_connected of the device. 404 unknown device, 409 device not active or without an HA token. There is no 503.

status.description: 202: rotation_requested (sent, waiting for the integration) or pending (integration not connected, or a device with remote access that is away: deferred until it connects, max. 72 h). 200: null.
